subject_definitions:

<Subject 4> is the short-haired young man in <Picture 4>, with closely cropped silver-gray hair and dark eye makeup, wearing a reflective silver bomber jacket over black clothing, loose black utility trousers, and chunky black shoes.

[reference generation] Create a five-second cinematic winter fantasy scene using the referenced characters and environment: <Subject 1> and <Subject 4> discuss dinner beneath <Subject 6>, while <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> approach from the snowy distance carrying <Subject 5>, join the conversation, joking about roasted fox until the frightened fox escapes from <Subject 3>'s arms.

detailed_description:
The target video is a cinematic winter-fantasy vignette with realistic character continuity, restrained theatrical humor, and a cool blue-gray snowy palette punctuated by red plum blossoms and vivid traditional costumes. Preserve the photographic costume references while adding natural movement, expressive reactions, and a clear progression from calm conversation to comic panic.
[Shot 1] Establish a medium-wide composition in the snowy red-plum forest from <Subject 6>, with the flowering tree filling the left foreground and a softly receding forest behind. <Subject 1> stands slightly left of center in her blue-and-gold traditional dress, while <Subject 4> stands to her right in the reflective silver jacket and black trousers. Snow falls steadily around them; their sleeves and loose clothing move gently in the cold air. The camera makes a slow lateral drift as they face one another and discuss dinner. <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[中文]晚上吃什么？</d> <Subject 4> (S2) answers, <d>[中文]吃点热乎的吧。</d> Their expressions are thoughtful but relaxed.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.350, widen and rack focus toward the snowy path in the background. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> emerge from the distant trees, walking toward the pair while holding <Subject 5> between them, with the white fox supported securely in <Subject 3>'s arms. Keep the red blossoms on the left as a strong composition anchor. The camera gently dollies backward as the approaching figures grow larger, their dark and red robes contrasting against the snow. <Subject 2> (S3) calls out, <d>[中文]我们也来想想。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:02.800, settle into a balanced medium group shot. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> join <Subject 1> and <Subject 4>; the fox remains visibly cradled against <Subject 3>'s red robe, ears alert and body tense. The four characters exchange amused glances while snow gathers lightly on their hair and sleeves. <Subject 3> (S4) leans toward the group and jokes, <d>[中文]那就烤狐狸吧。</d> <Subject 2> (S3) chuckles, <d>[中文]好主意。</d> The fox reacts immediately, eyes widening and ears flattening.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.050, push in quickly for the comic payoff. <Subject 5> twists out of <Subject 3>'s arms, drops onto the soft snow, and sprints toward the right side of the frame, its bushy tail streaming behind it. <Subject 3> reaches after it in surprise while the other three characters turn sharply and react. The camera performs a brief handheld follow-pan, keeping the fleeing white fox visible against the snowy forest. <Subject 5> lets out a frightened yelp, and <Subject 3> (S4) shouts, <d>[中文]等等！</d> End with the fox disappearing behind snow-laden brush as the group remains frozen in comic disbelief.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous soft snowfall, a quiet winter forest ambience, faint wind moving through bare branches and red plum blossoms, subtle fabric rustle from the flowing robes and jacket, snow compressing under footsteps, the fox's quick paw-steps and frightened yelp, followed by startled movement and falling snow during the escape.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained cinematic Chinese-fantasy score with low bowed strings, sparse guzheng-like plucked tones, and a light percussive accent during the fox's escape; no vocals.
